description: This file defines the 'Value' struct and associated methods for representing and manipulating structured values in the OpenTelemetry telemetry package, including JSON marshaling/unmarshaling and type conversions.

methods.name: StringValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a string.

methods.name: IntValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding an int, as an alias for Int64Value.

methods.name: Int64Value
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding an int64.

methods.name: Float64Value
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a float64.

methods.name: BoolValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a bool.

methods.name: BytesValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a byte slice.

methods.name: SliceValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a slice of Values.

methods.name: MapValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a slice of Attr key-value pairs.

methods.name: AsString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Value.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the string held by the Value; panics if not a string.

methods.name: AsInt64
methods.description: Returns the int64 value held by the Value.

methods.name: asInt64
methods.description: Returns the int64 held in the Value; assumes correct type.

methods.name: AsBool
methods.description: Returns the bool value held by the Value.

methods.name: asBool
methods.description: Returns the bool held in the Value; panics if not a bool.

methods.name: AsFloat64
methods.description: Returns the float64 value held by the Value.

methods.name: asFloat64
methods.description: Returns the float64 held in the Value; panics if not a float64.

methods.name: AsBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte slice held by the Value.

methods.name: asBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte slice held in the Value; panics if not bytes.

methods.name: AsSlice
methods.description: Returns the slice of Values held by the Value.

methods.name: asSlice
methods.description: Returns the slice of Values; panics if not a slice.

methods.name: AsMap
methods.description: Returns the slice of Attr key-value pairs held by the Value.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns the Attr slice; panics if not a map.

methods.name: Kind
methods.description: Returns the ValueKind of the Value.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the Value is empty (no value).

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if the Value is equal to another Value.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Value for debugging.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Encodes the Value into OTLP JSON format.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Decodes OTLP JSON data into the Value.
